title: Export Builds used Cached References Instead of Refreshing
body:
### Tested versions

Im using the latest stable version of Godot installed through Steam. v4.6.2.stable.steam [71f334935]





### System information

Windows 11

### Issue description


Im not sure how to reproduce the issue because its intermittent. 

What happened: I added new weapons to a Resource called ItemStorage:

```gdscript
extends Resource
class_name ItemStorage

@export var storage: Dictionary[Constants.Rarity, Array]
@export var allItems:Array[Item]

func setup_item_storage() -> void:
	print("Setting up ItemStorage")
	storage = {}
	for rarity in Constants.Rarity.values():
		storage[rarity] = []
	for item:Item in allItems:
		storage[item.rarity].append(item)
		print("%s added to Item Storage" % item.id)
```

The setup_item_storage() func is called from an Autoloaded Node called GameManager on _ready().
 

When i exported the game, the build had none of the new weapons. I was examining my github desktop to see if a resource was changed somewhere and nothing was there. I checked the GameManager node itself and the storage was linked correctly. It did not appear to have lost its link, especially since i added the weapons and played the game in the Editor and it worked fine. The issue only happened after exporting the game.

What i ended up doing was unlinking and relinking the ItemStorage resource from the GameManager. Again, there were no changes in Github Desktop when doing this. I exported the game and it worked after that. There's some sort of caching issue at play here. 

To me this is a pretty major bug especially if i want to push a build to production and the resources fail to update. There's no way of knowing which resources might not be getting refreshed due to this issue. 


### Steps to reproduce

its hard to reproduce this since im not entirely sure what even happened. 

Steps:

Create AutoLoad Node.
Link Resource to Node
Save

Add stuff to Resource
Save

Export

Add more stuff to resource
Save

Export

see if the Resource was updated for the build?
